collection.title: Alpina B3S 2008 to 2010 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Alpina B3S 2006 - 2008 requires a 24” wiper blade on the drivers side with a 19” for the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Pinch Tab arm attachment to fix the wiper blade to the arm.
